F16 stays the sitting case P6.282 and F30 stays with the owner's 2026-09-05 sitting answer, section 1.7 = B.

plan_rows.note_en: Implements option B of QF11 (owner 2026-09-11) for ledger F36, the family's last uncovered row. Done means the divergence from `interactive-mode.md#reverse-search-with-ctrl+r` is recorded with its date and its cost stated honestly — in fullscreen the documented feature cycles the scope through this session, this project and all projects, so refusing it refuses the whole feature and not a corner — and the reason sits where the behaviour is decided, in the composer module whose in-memory history is dropped on a session switch. No prompt text reaches disk, and the never-persist env spellings keep their existing meaning.

items.flip_reason_en: No runtime publishes a cross-session prompt store a host could read: the composer is ours, and the vendor's own prompt history belongs to its CLI REPL rather than to a hosted SDK session, so the refusal leaves no native lever unwired.
